conventions.convention: Work in ZF + AC. Compact-support triples have equivariant finite-rank complex bundles and a map invertible outside an invariant compact set; homotopies have one common compact support.
Principal symbols use ∂x ↦ iξ. The analytic index is kernel minus adjoint kernel; Fredholmness includes finite-dimensional defects and closed range.
The Koszul symbol uses exterior multiplication by w plus its Hermitian adjoint on Λ•W, from even to odd powers. On a complex line its map is z, and its zero-section class is λ₋₁(W).
The doubled real normal has complex structure J(v,η)=(-η♯,v♭), identified with the complexified real normal. Its invariant complex-bilinear metric identifies it with its complex dual.
Localization is at Sg={s∈R(T):s(g)≠0}. The normal inverse acts on the localized compact-support module; positive-dimensional fixed components retain the full exterior-power bundle class.
Orient T*F by (dθ)^n/n!, with θ=Σξj dxj. The plane Bott map is z=x+iξ, corresponding to [γ]−1. Using −dθ instead introduces the factor (−1)^n.

The compact character is the relative topological Chern character weighted by the eigenvalues of the element fixing the base; it is neither the zero-section alternating-bundle character nor a Borel degree-zero rank.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the equivariant compact-support triple groups, elliptic compact symbol, conditional Fredholm analytic index, exterior-algebra Koszul symbol, and doubled-real normal convention.

Assume AC. For compact smooth torus manifolds without boundary, the analytic symbol index is an R(T)-linear homomorphism. For a smooth equivariant embedding of compact manifolds, aT,M(j!c)=aT,Y(c). For the trivial group it equals the doubled-normal embedding pushforward; when g fixes Y pointwise, its character is the eigenvalue-weighted ordinary pushforward. The identities extend to representation localization.

Assume AC. For a smooth torus action on compact M without boundary and F=M^g, restriction along j:T*F→T*M is an isomorphism after Sg-localization in degrees zero and one. With e=λ₋₁(νℂ*), j*j!(b)=p*e·b and a=j!((p*e)⁻¹j*a).

Assume AC. For compact smooth F without boundary, possibly disconnected and nonorientable, with h fixing F pointwise, the trace-weighted compact-symbol pushforward equals the integral over T*F of chh,c(a)π*Td(TFℂ), with the stated dθ orientation. A localized quotient by the normal class has the corresponding full characteristic-class denominator.

seams_checked.note: The actual cited supplier is the equivariant slice-neighborhood lemma. Its compact-ambient hypotheses are preserved; localization Proof 7.1 separately constructs slices on noncompact T*M. Borel cohomological localization is not substituted for bundle K-localization.

The analytic comparison uses controlled realization, associated-bundle multiplicativity and O(k)-equivariant Bott normalization at their stated scopes. The sphere-bundle argument preserves the positive-order closure construction, controlled excision and z=x+iξ normalization.

The character theorem's F2 and L1–L3, and Proof 1.1–4.1, faithfully combine the compact symbol, analytic embedding compatibility, localized reconstruction and weighted characteristic pushforward. Full AC, first-order complexes, normal dual convention, cotangent orientation and full positive-dimensional denominator are preserved.
